systems.system: Sistema de Videovigilância, interlinked to the Órgão de Integração de Segurança Pública
systems.country_label: Sistema de Videovigilância; Órgão de Integração de Segurança Pública
systems.owner: Each authorised entity for its own cameras; the Órgão de Integração de Segurança Pública, by delegation of the head of the executive, has real-time or deferred access; the criminal police bodies (Polícia Nacional and Serviço de Investigação Criminal) may use their own fixed or mobile cameras
systems.tiers: Public places nationally; a legal regime, with no deployment figures

note: The video-surveillance law (with the tail of the witness-protection law and parliamentary resolutions in the same gazette): a legal regime for cameras, with nothing on station records. OCR text.
